scripts.env:setup: npm run env:setup --workspace frontend --if-present && npm run env:setup --workspace backend --if-present
scripts.frontend:dev:up: npm run wait:backend && npm run dev:frontend
scripts.frontend:start:up: npm run wait:backend && npm run start:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace frontend --if-present && npm run lint --workspace backend --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace frontend --if-present && npm run typecheck --workspace backend --if-present
scripts.data:export:seed: npm run strapi --workspace backend -- export -f seed --no-encrypt --no-compress
scripts.data:import:seed: npm run strapi --workspace backend -- import -f seed.tar
scripts.data:seed: npm run build --workspace backend && npm run seed --workspace backend
scripts.data:seed:reset: npm run build --workspace backend && npm run seed --workspace backend -- --reset
